title: fix(pm): the arm audit settles a measured Tier H past an unread input, names an edited carry hop, and the verifier refuses hand-offs in any spelling
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9AD2VXSxnSHsMRpLTGUwyMF)_
Fixes #33765

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：受管合并审计的低风险臂读数在“有读不到的输入、但已读到的输入本身就足以判 Tier H”时，改记 Tier H（并点名没读到什么），不再整条记为 NOT MEASURED；标签列表没读到也算“没读到”；被改过的 `Regen-provenance:` 承接行会在 BREACH 原因里点名；审稿档位校验器能识别驼峰、连字符写法和其他动词下的转交工具。
- 为什么改：#33762 评审留下的七条小尾巴（N-a…N-g），都朝“更保守/更说清楚”的方向收口，不改变今天任何一条判定的严格度。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `scripts/pm/` 下两个审计/校验脚本，不发布任何包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` 的 `armSettledWithoutUnread` 与 `readArmLanding` 的 N-e 段；`scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs` 的 `connectorHandsOff`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs --self-test`，预期分别 756 条断言通过、33 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Every hunk, by file and line range on the head (no hunk near the register/arm regions #33539 holds, L519 and L1339):

`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`
- L4466-4467 — `readArmLanding` jsdoc: one sentence naming the #33765 items.
- L4509-4517 — **N-a, N-b**: when the arm reads H and some input was unread, `armSettledWithoutUnread` decides whether the measured inputs alone settle it. If they do, the entry is `tier-h` with those reasons and an `unread` list; otherwise it stays `not-measured` with the old words.
- L4545-4547 — **N-c**: the N11 no-trusted-author-list branch's comment says it is defensive only (`loadRecordRecognisers` answers `available: false` instead, and a list it builds always holds the relay's login). No code change; `record-recognisers.mjs` untouched.
- L4592-4602 — **N-e**: when the unedited threads would have reached the record through a carry, each other edited row is left out of the unedited threads once; if that changes what the record leg would have read, the row is named on the BREACH reason as a `Regen-provenance:` hop.
- L4616-4618 — **N-g**: `reviewsAsLanded` jsdoc says a same-second dismissal is read as after the landing (pinned as is).
- L4641-4724 — **N-a, N-b, N-f** helpers: `armReadsNotMeasured` keeps its export and words (new optional `labels` argument), built on `armUnreadInputs`. `ARM_CHANGESET_SHOW` is the one spelling of the guard's `show SHA:PATH` read, used by the deletion exception and by `favourableArmGitRead`. `armSettledWithoutUnread` re-runs the guard's own `decomposeGovernedWork` → `readLowRiskTier` → `landsOnLowRiskArm`, answering each unread input the way that gives the arm no reason: a clean changeset, every path a modified regular file, no fork, no labels.
- L4736-4737 — `armCell`: a settled Tier H row also names what it was settled without.
- L9278-9323 — self-test: 11 new pins in the #33603 battery.

`scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs`
- L99-127 — **N-d**: `connectorToolWords` / `connectorHandsOff`. A connector tool's name is split into words (`_`, `-`, camelCase). It refuses when the first word is a hand-off verb (`send`, `message`, `start`, `fire`, `spawn`, `dispatch`, `delegate`, `interrupt`), or when it names a hand-off target (`session`, `agent`, `subagent`, `copilot`, `thread`, `trigger`, `worker`) under any first word except a read verb.
- L130 — `handsWorkToAnotherAgent` ORs the new check onto the exact names and the existing regexes. Nothing that refused before now passes.
- L299-307 — self-test: 3 new cases.

**Direction held.** No current Tier H verdict moves to S, and no not-measured verdict moves to measured S. N-a can only turn not-measured into `tier-h`, and only when the arm still reads H with every unread input answered its way. The arm's verdict is a conjunction of conditions, so the reasons that remain come from measured inputs. A read with no favourable answer (anything other than the guard's `show` or `diff-tree`), or a read that fails again, stays NOT MEASURED. N-b only moves `tier-h` to `not-measured`, or to `tier-h` when N-a settles it. N-d only adds refusals. N-e changes a BREACH reason's words, not its state. N-c and N-g are comments plus a pin.

**N-g: harmless, pinned as is.** GitHub times are whole seconds, so the order of a same-second dismissal and the landing cannot be known. The approval it restores is an authorized one, so the entry reads `cleared` (the maintainer's merge), never `pass`. Flipping it would turn a cleared row into a BREACH on a guess, so the behaviour is pinned instead.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test`: 745 → **756** assertions, exit 0 (head `7c84b661`).
- `node scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs --self-test`: 30 → **33** cases across 6 batteries, exit 0.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-governed-queue-guard.test.ts` (the one test file that spawns `check-governed-merges.mjs`), under the lock: Test Files 1/1, Tests 10/10, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- No forced test edits: every existing pin passes unchanged.

<details><summary>Ablations: 6 legs, each reds its pins and restores to the HEAD blob</summary>

Run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on 7c84b661. In every leg the anchor hit 1 → 0, and afterwards `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes.

| Leg | Mutation | Self-test | Pins that went red |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| N-a | `if (settled)` → `if (settled && false)` | exit 1, 3 failures | N-a measured-H (diff-tree + security label), N-a changeset/fork pair, N-b labels + Clause-② Tier H |
| N-b | delete the `its labels` unread push | exit 1, 1 failure | N-b unread labels alone is NOT MEASURED |
| N-e | `if (would?.carriedFrom)` → `… && false` | exit 1, 2 failures | N-e edited hop named, N-e edited claim beside a carry |
| N-f | `ARM_CHANGESET_SHOW` → `^refs/…` | exit 1, 4 failures | N-f spelling pin, #33729 N5 deleted-changeset control, N-a changeset pin, N-a no-favourable-answer pin |
| N-g | `at < landed` → `at <= landed` | exit 1, 1 failure | N-g same-second dismissal pinned as is |
| N-d | drop `\|\| connectorHandsOff(name)` | exit 1, 2 failures | N-d camelCase/hyphen verbs, N-d hand-off under other verbs |

N-c is a comment only, so it has no ablation.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` floors are not raised. The new pins join existing batteries, and raising a floor would be a hunk outside this card's regions. The seat can raise them when it lands.
- Same class as N-b, not changed here: a timeline answer that is not an array would still read inside `tier-h` through the guard's "its timeline was not read" reason. `fetchTimeline` throws instead (that path is already NOT MEASURED), so nothing reaches it today.
- N-d fails closed, as the existing shapes do. A target word under a non-read first word refuses even when the tool only reads (for example `archive_session`). The remedy is the same one the file already gives: review in an agent that calls none of these.
